chapters.title: The Evening Bell Falls Up
chapters.opening_condition: Mae maintains a South Hook tram line as the evening gravity bell begins a routine lean.
chapters.objective: Keep a loaded tram attached and learn why the official forecast is wrong.
chapters.closing_turn: The civic bell points toward the wall-sea instead of down.

sequences.title: Routine Weight
sequences.setting: South Hook tram gantry at coral dusk
sequences.objective: finish the anchor inspection before the bell
sequences.constraint: wind pushes spray upward and the line gauge trembles
sequences.action: Mae tests three pins and flags the fourth
sequences.consequence: the bell rings early and loose tools lift east

lettering.text: In Veyr, down arrives by schedule.

sequences.title: The Illegal Forecast
sequences.setting: gantry stairs rotating toward the sea
sequences.objective: reach the emergency brake
sequences.constraint: stairs are becoming a wall
sequences.action: Dax slides down a sailcloth line and offers a barometer reading
sequences.consequence: Mae follows his timing despite recognizing him as blacklisted

sequences.title: Tram in the Air
sequences.setting: tram span over South Hook
sequences.objective: stop the tram from falling sideways into the wall-sea
sequences.constraint: brake teeth cannot engage under lateral load
sequences.action: Mae loops the tow line around a stone rib while Dax vents the tram sail
sequences.consequence: the rib cracks but the tram swings into a survivable arc

sequences.title: First Knot
sequences.setting: underside of the suspended tram
sequences.objective: hold the tow line long enough for passengers to cross
sequences.constraint: Mae's glove splits and rope heat burns her palm
sequences.action: she consciously takes the pull into saltglass cord and ties a witness knot
sequences.consequence: the stored force glows yellow and her glove remains torn

sequences.title: A Clean Arrest
sequences.setting: tram platform after the swing
sequences.objective: account for the rescue
sequences.constraint: guards identify Dax and demand the illegal instrument
sequences.action: Mae releases her stored pull into a bollard to close a gate between them
sequences.consequence: the knot frays gray and Dax escapes as a wanted saboteur

sequences.title: The Wrong Down
sequences.setting: South Hook bell plaza at night
sequences.objective: read the civic plumb
sequences.constraint: official wardens cover the gauge
sequences.action: Dax projects his barometer shadow while Mae sights along the bell chain
sequences.consequence: everyone sees the plumb point horizontally into the sea

lettering.text: The schedule said the danger had passed.

chapters.title: Weight for Sale
chapters.opening_condition: South Hook wakes under emergency rationing while Crown terraces remain level.
chapters.objective: Reach the district engine and prove the load diversion.
chapters.closing_turn: Orra orders South Hook detached at dawn.

sequences.title: Breakfast on the Wall
sequences.setting: Tavi's tilted communal kitchen
sequences.objective: organize safe routes to the engine
sequences.constraint: pots and tables hang from ceiling hooks after the lean
sequences.action: Tavi maps blocked streets with bowls while Mae assigns ropes
sequences.consequence: Dax notices only Crown water remains vertical

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: The rich kept gravity with breakfast.

sequences.title: Gauge House
sequences.setting: exterior of the South Hook anchor engine
sequences.objective: enter the sealed gauge house
sequences.constraint: door weight has tripled and wardens hold the only crank
sequences.action: Mae builds a three-point haul while Dax bargains for one turn
sequences.consequence: the door opens without violence but the wardens sound an alarm

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Then let the Council lift it.

sequences.title: The Diverted Needle
sequences.setting: gauge chamber full of triangular dials
sequences.objective: trace missing weight
sequences.constraint: alarm shutters reduce the room to narrow light bands
sequences.action: Dax blows soot across pipes and Mae follows reversed airflow
sequences.consequence: they uncover a bypass feeding Crown terraces

sequences.title: Public Measure
sequences.setting: engine balcony above the ration queue
sequences.objective: decide whether to reveal the bypass immediately
sequences.constraint: panic could overload the remaining stairs
sequences.action: Mae carries the diversion gauge outside and Tavi keeps the crowd in anchored rows
sequences.consequence: the fraud becomes public without a stampede

sequences.title: Anchor-Heart
sequences.setting: engine core during a heat surge
sequences.objective: prevent the Council from remotely destroying evidence
sequences.constraint: brake coils ignite and the core cradle locks
sequences.action: Dax vents flame across his cape while Mae extracts the triangular anchor-heart
sequences.consequence: Dax's cape hem scorches and the district engine loses its portable regulator

sequences.title: Orra's Arithmetic
sequences.setting: projected Council address across the engine wall
sequences.objective: secure a repair window
sequences.constraint: Orra frames South Hook as a threat to city survival
sequences.action: Mae challenges her former mentor with the exposed gauge
sequences.consequence: Orra orders the district detached at dawn and names Mae compromised

lettering.speaker: orra
lettering.text: A city survives by choosing what holds.

lettering.speaker: orra
lettering.text: At dawn, South Hook is cut free.

chapters.title: Five Streets Sideways
chapters.opening_condition: Mae and Dax carry the anchor-heart toward an old maintenance route before South Hook is detached.
chapters.objective: Cross five rotating streets with the heart intact.
chapters.closing_turn: A tagged glass skate emerges from a wall-sea crack.

sequences.title: Cradle Rules
sequences.setting: rope bridge above the first sideways street
sequences.objective: balance the anchor-heart cradle
sequences.constraint: its internal weight shifts opposite each step
sequences.action: Mae shortens her side while Dax calls the oscillation
sequences.consequence: they establish a five-step carrying rhythm

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Name the swing, not the fear.

sequences.title: Market Roll
sequences.setting: second street, market stalls sliding east
sequences.objective: reach the fixed arcade
sequences.constraint: barrels accelerate across wet stone
sequences.action: Dax angles awnings into brakes while Mae anchors the cradle behind a fountain
sequences.consequence: merchants escape but food stores spill into the sea

lettering.speaker: merchant
lettering.text: Leave the grain. Take the people.

sequences.title: The Hidden Route
sequences.setting: third street beneath a folding aqueduct
sequences.objective: use Dax's unlisted shortcut
sequences.constraint: support marks show recent deliberate cuts
sequences.action: Dax admits he knew the route was failing but expected it to last one crossing
sequences.consequence: the aqueduct buckles between them and the exit

sequences.title: Inspectors in the Fold
sequences.setting: collapsed aqueduct channel
sequences.objective: choose between the schedule and trapped Council inspectors
sequences.constraint: water pressure rises and the anchor-heart cannot get wet
sequences.action: Mae wedges the cradle high, braces a slab, and frees the inspectors while Dax diverts flow
sequences.consequence: her right sleeve tears, ribs bruise, and their supply pack washes away

sequences.title: Fourth and Fifth
sequences.setting: two stacked streets turning in opposite directions
sequences.objective: clear the final crossings before the next lean
sequences.constraint: Mae cannot carry on her injured side
sequences.action: the inspectors take her load under explicit instruction while Dax counterwalks the cradle
sequences.consequence: Mae accepts distributed labor and the group reaches the sea rib

sequences.title: Tagged Visitor
sequences.setting: cracked maintenance rib beside the vertical sea
sequences.objective: find the route into the rib
sequences.constraint: sea pressure pulses through a hairline crack
sequences.action: Mae touches the crack as Dax measures each pulse
sequences.consequence: a translucent glass skate squeezes through with a Council tag embedded in its fin

lettering.text: The sea knocked from the other side.

chapters.title: The Animal in the Equation
chapters.opening_condition: The injured glass skate flees into a maintenance rib while Mae's bruised ribs worsen.
chapters.objective: Trace the Council tag and learn what is disturbing the wall-sea.
chapters.closing_turn: They find an engine chain embedded in a juvenile keelback.

sequences.title: Pressure Dress
sequences.setting: dry pocket inside the sea rib
sequences.objective: stabilize Mae's injury before pursuit
sequences.constraint: their supplies were lost and every breath shifts the chamber
sequences.action: Dax cuts a compression wrap from his scorched cape lining
sequences.consequence: Mae can move but cannot twist or carry high

sequences.title: Through the Gill
sequences.setting: flooded maintenance membrane
sequences.objective: follow the skate through a breathing valve
sequences.constraint: the passage alternates air and crushing water
sequences.action: Dax times their crawl to the skate's fin pulses
sequences.consequence: they enter safely but Dax exhausts his breath

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: In on yellow. Out on black.

sequences.title: Harvest Rig
sequences.setting: Council pressure lab hidden in the rib
sequences.objective: inspect the tag apparatus
sequences.constraint: automatic clamps close on motion
sequences.action: Mae uses a dropped bolt to trigger each clamp while Dax crawls the quiet path
sequences.consequence: they find drained saltglass sacs and living capture records

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Finally, a room that dislikes me honestly.

sequences.title: Free the Measure
sequences.setting: capture cradle above a pressure sluice
sequences.objective: choose whether to harvest the skate's organ for a repair knot
sequences.constraint: freeing it opens a water gate toward them
sequences.action: Mae cuts the tag while Dax takes the first blast and consciously stores its breath pressure
sequences.consequence: the skate escapes and Dax's new breath-knot glows

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: One organ could hold a district.

sequences.title: Animal Current
sequences.setting: outer observation blister inside the vertical sea
sequences.objective: follow the freed skate's route
sequences.constraint: the blister flexes under enormous passing mass
sequences.action: they anchor the heart and flatten against the rib as a juvenile keelback swims past
sequences.consequence: the skate circles a wound on the larger creature

lettering.text: The wall-sea moved around something larger than weather.

sequences.title: The Chain
sequences.setting: deep rib aperture beside the keelback
sequences.objective: identify the cause of the wound
sequences.constraint: each tail stroke yanks the city anchor line
sequences.action: Mae sights the tension while Dax releases his breath-knot to clear bubbles
sequences.consequence: they see a barbed Council engine chain embedded in the juvenile

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Line enters flesh. Load returns to Veyr.
Above them, the city called it stability.
